# OversizedContentError

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Raised when content that cannot split across pages is taller than a page and the document's `settings.oversizedContent` is `'throw'`. With the default, `'clip'`, the content is drawn at the top of a page, cut off at the bottom of the body, and an error diagnostic is recorded instead.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `BonniePdfError`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new OversizedContentError(message: string)
```
